value.name: Micky sleeps off the night on his couch
value.description: Micky is found asleep in his clothes on the couch in his apartment, suggesting he has been drinking or otherwise numbing himself after the previous night.
evidence: Micky lies sleeping in his clothes on the couch, bandages on his head.
MICKY'S STILL SLEEPING IN HIS CLOTHES ON THE COUCH

value.name: Micky wakes and self-medicates
value.description: Micky wakes up, gets beer and pain pills, and appears to be managing his injuries and hangover with substances.
evidence: He gets up and walks into the small kitchen, grabs a beer out of the refrigerator, swallows some PAIN pills.

value.name: Micky hesitates to call Charlene
value.description: Micky picks up Charlene's napkin with her number, starts dialing, then stops and hangs up without calling her.
evidence: And picks up the cocktail NAPKIN WITH CHARLENE'S NUMBER AND HEART ON IT.
Picks up the phone, starts to dial, stops, looks at the number. Hangs up the phone.

value.name: Micky falls back asleep
value.description: After failing to call Charlene, Micky returns to the couch and falls asleep again.
evidence: Goes back into the living room and lies down on the couch and falls asleep again.

value.name: Charlene arrives and knocks on Micky's door
value.description: The next morning, Charlene comes to Micky's apartment and bangs on the door, trying to get his attention.
evidence: He is woken by BANGING ON HIS DOOR.
AND SEES CHARLENE STANDING ON HIS DOORSTEP.

value.name: Charlene confronts Micky about not calling
value.description: Charlene calls out to Micky, saying she saw him and demanding to know why he did not call her the day before.
evidence: CHARLENE (OS) I saw your shadow. And I heard you talk two seconds ago!
Why don't you open the door and tell me to my face why you didn't call me yestahday?

value.name: Micky opens the door to Charlene
value.description: After hesitating, Micky opens the door and Charlene sees his bandaged face, reacting with surprise.
evidence: Micky thinks, goes to the door, opens it.
Charlene is slightly taken aback by his bandaged face.
